messages:
Sam P: Helionix RFI incoming. They want a single ZIP with: capability matrix, redacted HSM attestation, PoC runbook, and pricing scenarios. Can we split owners?
Nina K: I can do the PoC runbook + ops window. Prefer weekend provisioning to avoid their ETL jobs.
Jorge L: I'll take the capability matrix and the security Q&A (Q7/KMS details).
Sam P: Thanks. High-level customer asks: EU-only data at rest, FIPS HSM proof, SLA 99.9 p95 <150ms for generation at 256 tokens, and cost estimate for 500k calls/day over 60 days.
Nina K: Ops constraints noted. Can we provision a dedicated 6xA100 pool in Ireland? deploy-bot: available regions for dedicated pools -> EU-W, EU-C.
deploy-bot: Tentative capacity available in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1. Please confirm size and date to create hold.
Jorge L: For the capability matrix, proposed columns: Feature | Supported | Deployment | EU Residency | HSM Integration | SLA (p95) | Typical p95 (256 tokens) | Scale (QPS) | Notes. Agree?
Sam P: Yes. Add a column for "Documentation/Attachment" to link attestation or diagram.
Jorge L: Good call. I'll seed rows for Text Gen, Chat, Embeddings, Rerank, Custom Tooling.
Nina K: PoC runbook draft outline: 1) Provision weekend (setup), 2) Smoke tests + perf baseline, 3) Traffic replay (client-provided dataset), 4) Security verification (red-team check), 5) Handover + support. Can we do setup on 2026-04-18 07:00-11:00 UTC?
Sam P: That date works for customer. Nina, please add rollback steps and contact list (oncall, infra, account rep).
Nina K: Will do. Also add a small script snippet for reproducing perf tests.
Jorge L: Security Q7 (KMS/HSM): we can state we support customer-managed keys via KMIP/HSM integrations for private and dedicated deployments. We cannot include raw attestation in the public ZIP; sec-team-bot: please advise on redaction rules.
sec-team-bot: Redaction policy: remove serial numbers and IP addresses. Attestation documents may be shared as redacted PDFs; full attestations shared only over SFTP with NDA.
Sam P: OK note that in the RFI answer: "HSM attestation available (redacted) in package; full attestation available on request via secure channel after NDA."
deploy-bot: Hold placed: tentative dedicated pool for 2026-04-18 provisioning window. Please confirm PO to finalize.
finance-bot: For pricing, two scenarios ready: Hosted (PAYG) and Reserved commit (monthly). Estimate assumptions: avg tokens/call=650, token mix text/embeddings=90/10.
finance-bot: Draft estimates for 500k calls/day over 60 days -> Hosted: ~$1,080,000 (token/embedding), Reserved: $88,000/mo reserved pool + $0.10/token overage -> ~$564,000 total (estimate). Will attach CSV.
Jorge L: Oof those are wide. Add notes: reserved assumes 8xA100 equivalence and sustained utilization; hosted assumes burst/overhead.
Sam P: Attachments checklist: capability_matrix_v1.csv, poc_runbook_v1.md, redacted_hsm_attestation_v1.pdf, pricing_scenarios_v1.csv, network_diagram_redacted.png. Jorge/Nina: can you upload final versions by 2026-04-02 EOD?
Nina K: I'll upload runbook + diagram by EOD 2026-04-01.
Jorge L: I'll finish matrix + security answers and upload by 2026-04-02 morning.
sam P: I'll draft a short cover email and legal note about NDA for full attestation. Also confirm who owns the email send.
Jorge L: I can send the RFI package once all attachments are in and finance confirms numbers. Marking items in the spreadsheet with follow-ups.
finance-bot: Uploaded: helionix_pricing_scenarios_v1.csv -> https://drive.redwood/helionix_pricing_scenarios_v1.csv
Nina K: Uploaded: helionix_poc_runbook_v1.md -> https://drive.redwood/helionix_poc_runbook_v1.md
sec-team-bot: Uploaded: redacted_hsm_attestation_v1.pdf -> https://drive.redwood/redacted_hsm_attestation_v1.pdf (redacted per policy).
Jorge L: Uploaded: helionix_capability_matrix_v1.csv -> https://drive.redwood/helionix_capability_matrix_v1.csv. Left comment on Embeddings row about private on-prem support timeline.
Sam P: Great work everyone. Target to send final RFI bundle by 2026-04-05 COB. Quick win: Jorge, add the "attestation available on request" text in the matrix doc where appropriate.
Jorge L: Done. Also flagged a potential enterprise blocker: Helionix requires FedRAMP-like audit logs for dedicated pools; raising to compliance for a gap analysis.
sec-team-bot: Noted. Compliance team to schedule gap analysis call.
Sam P: Thanks. If anything blocks delivery, post here. Otherwise I'll draft send email after uploads complete. :email:
